name: slm-cost-benchmark-testset-1000
description: A testset intended to measure inference cost/efficiency tradeoffs for language models (e.g., latency, token throughput, and monetary compute cost) across 1000 examples. The set is used to compare runtime and cost behaviors rather than purely language-quality metrics.
evaluation_method: cost and latency metrics (tokens/sec, ms per request, $ cost per 1K tokens) and optionally token-level throughput/regression error where applicable
reputation: Small, user-contributed benchmark on Hugging Face with limited adoption outside the dataset author and early testers.
